model.name: ideal_rectified_pinhole
assumptions: pixel point and intrinsics use the same continuous image coordinate convention
point is expressed in the matching camera/projector frame

negative_controls_required: NaN or infinity in pixel coordinates must reject
NaN or infinity in intrinsics must reject
round-trip test must not use the candidate function to generate its own expected pixel
frame/units assumptions must be stated outside the numerical vector
limitations: Proposed analytic fixture, not yet consumed by a fixture verifier.
No pose transformation, distortion correction or real-device calibration is performed.
The depth is a model-coordinate value, not measured scene depth.
